0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers (3-1, 2-0 on the road) head to Utah for their fifth game of the season, sitting second in the Northwest and half a game back of the division lead after a loss in their most recent game. The Jazz (1-4) have dropped three straight, are fifth in the Northwest, and are 3 games back. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (ankle, soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), with Robert Williams III (knee) listed as a game-time decision, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot, strain), and Trey Alexander (knee, bruise), with Lauri Markkanen (wrist) also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and Portland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season series, including a 124-114 win in Portland in their last matchup.
